parent_objective: design a source-expanded repeat for fresh ambiguity history interventions after M1535 audit
blocked_by: M1534 positives are source-small T4-only and reset/zero-current controls dominate max gap

public_gates: M1536 must design a source-expanded repeat before any candidate materialization
M1536 must preserve all intervention channel separations from M1534
M1536 must pre-register source-diversity and T5 inclusion checks
M1536 must not run training PPO promotion private holdout or new candidate export
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run the repeat during design
do not claim level3 self-identification from M1534 or M1536 design

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: pre-registers a source-expanded repeat design for M1534 promising but source-small history-intervention positives
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no repeat run, candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the repeat design does not increase source scope beyond M1534
stop if it omits reset zero-current or donor response/action controls
stop if it routes directly to candidate materialization
stop if it changes actor input contract
fallback_plan: route to pair repair if source-expanded mining cannot produce accepted pairs
route to task generation if T5 terminal-boundary rows remain absent
route to branch synthesis if repeated controls dominate history interventions
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1535 admitted repeat design after source-small positive smoke

admission_evidence: M1535 audited M1534 as positive but source-small and blocked materialization
blocked_shortcuts: do not run the repeat during design
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation manifest if design passes
next_stage_criteria: pass and fail thresholds are explicit
T5 inclusion or absence handling is explicit
candidate materialization remains blocked until repeat audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1536 must design repeat controls that keep reset zero-current and donor response/action channels separate because M1534 controls dominated the max gap.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Design only for a later source-expanded public repeat.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the later repeat is null or controls dominate, record the negative result and route to pair repair or branch synthesis instead of weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A source-expanded repeat can test whether M1534 wrong-history and donor-response positives survive more measured pairs and broader source families before any materialization.
success_criteria: design increases source scope beyond the 3 accepted M1534 pairs
design preserves wrong-history donor-response delayed reset zero-current channels
design pre-registers source-diversity pass criteria and T5 inclusion handling
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: design only repeats the same 3 M1534 pairs
design routes directly to training promotion private holdout or materialization
decision_rule: M1536 passes if it pre-registers a source-expanded repeat protocol without running the repeat or weakening guardrails.
